description.en:

*   zh: Chinese
*   en: English

description.zh: 命名空间接入MSE服务治理的对应信息。
description.en: The information about the namespace for which Microservices Engine(MSE) Microservices Governance is enabled.

description.zh: 对应的微服务命名空间，为空代表没有接入。
description.en: The microservice namespace. If you do not specify this parameter, Microservice Governance is not enabled for the namespace.
The name of the Kubernetes namespace.
The ID of the region in which the instance resides. The region is supported by MSE.

title.zh: 更新已接入服务治理的集群信息

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mse modify-governance-kubernetes-cluster --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cluster-id cd23228b3c80c4d4f9ad87cc30000 --namespace-infos MseNamespace=default Name=default --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun mse ModifyGovernanceKubernetesCluster --region cn-hangzhou --ClusterId cd23228b3c80c4d4f9ad87cc30000 --AcceptLanguage zh --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --NamespaceInfos '[{"MseNamespace":"default","Name":"default"}]'
